Account Reconciliation: Regularly reconcile customer accounts to ensure balances are accurate and up to date. Aging Report Management: Maintain and monitor accounts receivable aging reports, following up on overdue accounts and escalating problematic cases as needed. Customer Communication: Build and maintain relationships with customers to resolve billing and payment issues, and negotiate payment plans when necessary.
